articles.title: Historic England win shows confident Japan can go far at World Cup
articles.mainIdea: Historic England win shows confident Japan can go far at World Cup
articles.summary: AFP: Historic England win shows confident Japan can go far at World Cup. Coach Hajime Moriyasu cautioned it was only a friendly, but Japan's slice of history with a statement 1-0 win over England at Wembley shows they could go deep at the World Cup."Coming to the World Cup, I know it will be a totally different team for England," said the coach, whose side beat Scotland 1-0 on Saturday in Glasgow.

articles.title: IOWN Energy Facilitates Financing and Sale of 127 MW Battery Project in Nevada
articles.mainIdea: IOWN Energy Facilitates Financing and Sale of 127 MW Battery Project in Nevada
articles.summary: PR Newswire: IOWN Energy Facilitates Financing and Sale of 127 MW Battery Project in Nevada. On February 13, 2026, IOWN Energy (IOWN), on behalf of its client Eolus North America, Inc (Eolus), completed the successful sale of the 127 MW / 506 MWh Roccasecca standalone battery energy storage project, located in Boulder City, Nevada, to DESRI, a leading independent power producer. The transaction was completed as an all-cash sale and includes the transfer of all shares of the Roccasecca special purpose vehicle (SPV) to the buyer. Related tickers mentioned: EOLU-B.ST, ISP.MI.
